title: chore(ui-components): set execution permissions on version script
body:
**Summary**

[Scheduled release fails](https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/algolia/instantsearch/10118/workflows/38386108-8521-4f83-8350-b82d971f79d3/jobs/49156?invite=true#step-105-3797_47) because it cannot execute the version check on the new instantsearch-ui-components package. This sets the correct permissions for the script that needs to be run.
